acceptanceCriteria: Reads report when they ran a full audit because no valid checkpoint existed, as a non-failing warning or a field in the result, without writing anything (invariant 4).
Writers report a failed retention in their result without failing the transaction (CAL-V0-060).
body: Found by the V1-1051/V1-1057 work on 2026-10-09. internal/tasks/store/guards.go:115-129 tolerates checkpoint create, write and rename failures silently, as CAL-V0-060 requires (best-effort; a failed retention must not fail or change the transaction). CAL-V0-059 says a lost checkpoint costs one full audit. The observability gap: retention that keeps failing is visible only as 2-3 s reads. On this machine the real store ran without a checkpoint for days because the installed runtime predated it, and nothing reported that.
title: corvint-tasks: surface repeated checkpoint retention failures instead of only slow reads
